Name: AudioDuck
Author: xenside
Description: Per-app audio ducking: when one app plays (e.g. Discord), others get quieter. Each key is set up in its own settings; tapping it turns it off and on, and its colour shows whether it is off, listening or ducking right now. Runs while Stream Deck runs.

Actions.Name: Ducking
Actions.Tooltip: Set up which apps trigger ducking and which get quieter in the key settings; tap to turn it off and on.
